purpose: Retrospective as-of-safe component diagnostic inside the single quick-evidence-v1 candidate. Tests whether prior same-bill non-passage recorded votes contain incremental signal beyond the serving Quick baseline without redefining those ambiguous votes as support/opposition.

asOfPolicy.source: official bill-linked member_votes joined to vote_events
asOfPolicy.reason: Historical vote-event timestamps are date-only, so same-day ordering is not provable.

fit.model: ridge logistic offset on serving Quick logit
selectionMetricOrder: validation chamber mean absolute yes-vote error

interpretation.validationUse: hypothesis generation for continued prospective measurement only
